name: After § 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 3a. Recalls that the energy sector is of utmost strategic importance and a fundamental requirement for the economic development of the Union; invites the Member States, therefore, to intervene in any way they deem necessary to guarantee low energy prices for local communities and industry, including price caps, supporting local citizens’ energy cooperatives, democratic ownership of energy companies and build-up of publicly owned infrastructure;
